items.quote: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
items.claim: According to the text, Moses and the children of Israel sang a song to the LORD celebrating his triumph, in which the horse and its rider were thrown into the sea. Passes 1 and 2 agreed on this item. Pass 3 was empty. Based only on model-prior knowledge, this is Exodus 15:1 (KJV), the Song of the Sea. The document itself only labels it '15:1'.
items.actor: Moses and the children of Israel
items.object: the LORD; horse and rider thrown into the sea
items.mechanism: divine triumph (as described by the text)
items.place: the sea (not named in the passage)
